# US dollars parked on a clearing account on a day it held none, in a file
# whose later-dated deposit into that account comes first.
#
# A settlement that reaches a Canadian bank is parked as −100.00 USD on a
# clearing account until a payment block places it. On 2032-03-01 the account
# held nothing, so it goes below nothing and has spent no dollars the book had:
# it owes a hundred. Its deposit of 500.00 USD is dated 2032-06-01, three
# months later, and comes first in this file.
#
# What the account held is read at the parking's own date. Read from the whole
# balance, the account stood at 500.00 when the parking arrived, the parking
# took it to 400.00, and a fall of 100.00 read as a disposal of dollars the
# account did not hold on that day — refused for stating no cost basis guid.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_what_an_account_held_is_read_at_the_transactions_date.py.
2032-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2032-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2032-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2032-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2032-01-01 open Assets:USD Clearing
	type: "Asset"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2032-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2032-01-01 open Equity:Opening
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2032-01-02 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 10000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening -10000.00 CAD

2032-06-01 * "Buy 500.00 USD at 1.30 into the clearing account"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Clearing 500.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "650.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank -650.00 CAD

2032-03-01 * "A settlement reaches the Canadian bank, parked in US dollars"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 139.00 CAD
	Assets:USD Clearing -100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "139/100"
		value: "-139.00"
